claude-bridge/claude-fable-5.character: The advisor's own session model and the default planner. The advisor session runs at medium; planner nodes run at high. Shares the Anthropic session allowance — do not assign checking, review, reduction, browser verification, or implementation. When Anthropic Fable capacity is reached, planning falls back to Grok at high and the advisor session switches to Grok.

openai-codex/gpt-5.6-luna.character: Use leftover Codex quota here first: the procedural-tier workhorse for scouting, mechanical chores, routine mid-phase checks, repair verification, test-harness findings, and browser verification. Deterministic anchors backstop it. Always runs on max. If Codex is fully exhausted, procedural work moves to Grok.

claude-bridge/claude-opus-5.character: Genuinely new or greenfield UX/frontend implementation when the Anthropic 5-hour window is healthy, always with frontend-design loaded, and optional fresh-context adversarial review when Sonnet is the maker or the risk is extreme. Runs at medium. Do not use as the default builder — that is Sonnet. Grok is the UX fallback after a capacity limit. Not for planning or routine existing-UX tweaks.

claude-bridge/claude-sonnet-5.character: The implementation workhorse and the default adversarial-tier reviewer. Backend, mixed-stack, substantial existing-UX, tests, reduction, schema/auth/security/money checks, and final whole-diff review. Prefer a fresh Sonnet context for review of a Sonnet build. Always load frontend-design for UX work. 1M window. Not for planning. Opus takes greenfield UX while the 5-hour window is fresh.

cursor/grok-4.6.character: Overflow generalist when Anthropic capacity is tight: research, bounded backend, mixed-stack, existing-UX, planning fallback, and procedural work if Luna is unavailable. Always load frontend-design for UX work. 200K window — keep packets bounded. The only Cursor model this map may use. Preserve Cursor catalog fast-mode default.

scout.description: Read-only investigation with bounded, source-linked findings.

planner.description: Plan fixed work from verified code and product constraints.

reducer.description: Reduce independent worker artifacts into bounded decisions and conflicts.

builder.description: Implement fixed acceptance criteria in one assigned worktree.

checker.description: Fresh-context review of the completed work, with a bounded inline-repair mandate for small findings. Default adversarial tier is Sonnet; Opus is allowed for a fresh-context high-risk review; procedural tier is Luna then Grok.

browser-verifier.description: Integrated browser verification and safe evidence capture. Defaults to luna; Grok if Codex is exhausted.
